Technology X Fashion Performance
Thermaltake has been committed to delivering the perfect user experience while working on our mission to build “a cultural brand for the
enjoyment of entertainment, e-Sports, technology, and lifestyle.”
Celebrating Thermaltake’s 25th Anniversary, we chose Hydrangea Blue as the special color of the year. This refreshing shade of blue blends
vitality with elegance and carries the spirit of an audacious creator.
In this era of individuality and diversity, our commitment to bridge fashion and technology elements has established us as the pioneer of
leading trends. With a daring attitude, let’s leap into a brand new age of creativity!
Power Up Next Generation Hardware
Built for next-gen hardware, the Toughpower GF A3 Hydrangea Blue 1050W is compatible with Intel ATX 3.1 specifications and comes with a native
PCIe 12V-2x6 connector. The GF A3 Hydrangea Blue 1050W delivers 80 PLUS Gold efficiency, it also offers stability, durability, and
reliability.
Fully Compatible with Intel ATX 3.1 Standards
Toughpower GF A3 Hydrangea Blue 1050W is fully compatible with Intel ATX 3.1 Specifications which supports up to 200% power excursion, reaches
60% low load efficiency and complies with required power supply timing standards.

PCIe Gen 5.1 Ready
Toughpower GF A3 Hydrangea Blue 1050W comes with a native PCIe 12V-2x6 connector to offer powerful and stable performance allowing the PSU to
natively run next-generation GPUs.
The wattage marked on the PCIe 12+4 connector is the recommended wattage. (Ref. Intel design guideline) The native PCIe 12+4pin (12V-2x6)
connector of the GF A3 Hydrangea Blue 1050W can deliver up to 600W for graphics cards.
Note:
Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power demand. Actual power demands may vary based on specific components, usage, and many
other factors.
Please follow the recommended power requirements from the GPU manufactures before using the PCIe 12+4pin cable.
Made to Comply with the Latest Graphics Cards
Ready to supply graphics cards according to their different ways of connections, The GF A3 Hydrangea Blue 1050W is designed to support NVIDIA
and AMD graphics cards, it supports 3 x 8-pin slots for AMD graphics cards & entry RTX 40 series graphics cards, it also comes with a 1 x
12V-2x6 connector for RTX 40 series cards that with a PCIe Gen 5.1 connector.

Be Smart, Stay Quiet
Features a 120mm fluid bearing fan to deliver excellent airflow. Furthermore, the Smart Zero Fan will adjust the fan speed and minimizes
undesired noise.
80 PLUS® Gold Certified
80 PLUS Gold certification means the Toughpower GF A3 Hydrangea Blue 1050W converts power efficiently, saves energy through its high efficiency
up to 90%, resulting in lower power loss and heat buildup inside the power supply.
High Quality Main Japanese Capacitor
High quality main Japanese capacitor greatly improves the power supplies durability and ensures the Toughpower GF A3 Hydrangea Blue 1050W is
stability and reliability.
High Amperage Single +12V Rail & DC to DC Design
Powerful single +12V rail can properly deliver the power you need for the best compatibility. The use of LLC and DC to DC circuit design
provides very stable operation and enhanced voltage regulation.
